description:
* £1,000 RENT CREDIT *

Zero deposit option available

Welcome to Triangle Yard.

Step inside our beautifully designed apartments and you'll find yourself surrounded by top-of-the-line finishes and sleek modern features. With a range of floor plans to choose from, you're sure to find the perfect layout to suit your needs. Our living areas are ideal for entertaining guests or simply relaxing after a long day, while our fully equipped kitchens offer everything you need to whip up a gourmet meal.

Perched on the edge of Leeds City Centre, Triangle Yard offers stylish new build apartments with amenities including communal residents lounges, co-working spaces and outdoor space. Modern homes designed for connected community living.

Inside your new home, you'll get: 
* A spacious open-plan kitchen/living area with modern kitchen appliances including; a ceramic induction hob, extractor, oven, fridge freezer and dishwasher
* Modern bathroom with shower and bath, and one en-suite bathroom with shower 
* Fully furnished; double- or king-sized ottoman beds with mattresses, built-in wardrobes, bedside tables, dining table and chairs, sofa, media unit and coffee table
* Floor to ceiling windows
* Secure key card and video door entry system

That's not all, you'll also benefit from all of these Neighbourhood perks:
* Professional management and friendly 24/7 on-site team
* Purrfectly pet-friendly apartments
* On-site maintenance, here to help when you need them
* Complimentary access to residents' lounges, co-working spaces and an outdoor space
* Resident events; puppy yoga or garden parties - you control the calendar
* Exclusive local and nationwide discounts such as money off your Gym Group membership or spice up your meal times with a free trial of Simply Cook. 
* The option to paint feature walls, make your apartment truly yours
* Super-fast Wi-Fi options where you can pick the package right for you

With plenty of transport options and local attractions nearby:
*3-minute walk to Second City Coffee
*5-minute walk to Pret A Manger, Wellington Street
*6-minute walk to Tesco Express, Wellington Street
*8-minute walk to Park Square
*9-minute walk to Green Room
*9-minute walk to Leeds canal, where residents can enjoy a walk to Kirkstall Abbey
*10-minute walk to Leeds Train Station
*11-minute walk to Co-op Food, Burley Street
*11-minute walk to Leeds Art Gallery
*12-minute walk to Trinity Leeds Shopping Centre
*12-minute walk to Leeds City Centre
*13-minute walk to Millennium Square
*17-minute walk to University of Leeds
*19-minute walk to Leeds Grand Theatre
*19-minute walk to Leeds Corn Exchange
*19-minute walk to Victoria Gate Shopping Centre
*20-minute walk to John Lewis

Be fully at home, at Triangle Yard. Book your viewing to come see it for yourself.

Your Home, By ila

*Rent Credit Offer* The £1,000 rent credit will be applied as credit to the 3rd months' rent. You must have signed by 30th Sept 2026 and moved in by 31st October 2026 to be eligible for this offer. Terms & Conditions apply, speak to the team for more details.

Disclaimer: Whilst every attempt has been made to ensure the accuracy of the photographs, virtual tours, and floor plans presented on this listing, they are for illustrative purposes only and may not accurately reflect the actual size, layout, or furniture included. Please note that furnishings and decor are not included unless explicitly stated in the listing description. Interested parties are advised to speak to the Triangle Yard team for any clarity or further information.
